svg.title: Power-to-X superstructure: candidate technologies and the selected design
svg.desc: Orthographic superstructure for a hydrogen-based water-energy-food system. Resources (solar, wind, seawater) feed candidate technologies (battery, PEM electrolyzer, reverse-osmosis desalination, hydrogen storage tank, Haber-Bosch ammonia synthesis, methanation) that supply products (power, hydrogen, ammonia, methane, water). Each technology carries a binary build decision y in {0,1}. The drawn selection (solid, y=1) is electrolyzer, desalination, storage and Haber-Bosch; battery and methanation stay candidates (dashed, y=0). Nitrogen and carbon dioxide enter as battery-limit feeds. Every selected unit has its inputs supplied and its outputs consumed.
